title: Genocide at the Security Council
description:
Data pipeline, computational analysis and interactive dashboard studying the use of the word genocide and its semantic neighbourhood in United Nations Security Council speeches, 1946–2024. The corpus is Sakamoto and Matsuoka, The UNSC Meetings and Speeches, version 5.0 (Harvard Dataverse, CC0).

The model-derived labels in this repository are unvalidated: the human gold sample has not yet been coded. See docs/CLAIMS.md for the status of each kind of figure.
